units.source_text: 昨夜那种丑态如果被那人闻知，我这一身就两头落空了！”

en.t: If that person hears about my disgraceful behavior last night, I will lose everything on both sides!
He sighed several times, then went out the door and left.

units.source_text: 到了玉鬘那里，觉得才隔一夜，她的容貌忽然增艳，

en.t: When he reached Tamakazura's place, he felt that after only one night apart, her beauty had suddenly grown more radiant,

units.source_text: 他就越发专心地爱她，绝不再分心到别的女人身上去。

en.t: and he loved her all the more devotedly, never again letting his heart stray toward any other woman.

units.source_text: 他想起家中之事不胜厌恶，

en.t: When he thought of matters at home, he was overwhelmed with disgust,

units.source_text: 便长久笼闭在玉鬘房中，不想回家去了。

en.t: so he shut himself away for a long time in Tamakazura's rooms and no longer wished to go home.
